steps.en: After the third letter, the notice becomes due for an electronic reminder
steps.id: Setelah surat ketiga, notice jadi kandidat reminder elektronik

steps.en: The owner's latest mobile number is checked with the government source
steps.id: Nomor mobile terbaru pemilik dicek ke sumber data pemerintah
steps.why_en: The check is switched off by a setting; the stored number is reused.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan dimatikan lewat setting; nomor yang tersimpan dipakai ulang.

steps.en: The company's latest email is checked with the government source
steps.id: Email terbaru company dicek ke sumber data pemerintah
steps.why_en: The check is switched off by a setting; the stored email is reused.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan dimatikan lewat setting; email yang tersimpan dipakai ulang.

steps.en: The refreshed contact details are saved on the notice
steps.id: Kontak yang diperbarui disimpan di notice
steps.why_en: Saving only happens when the switched-off check runs.
steps.why_id: Penyimpanan hanya terjadi bila pengecekan yang dimatikan itu jalan.

steps.en: Only owners with a usable contact are prepared for the reminder
steps.id: Hanya pemilik dengan kontak yang bisa dipakai disiapkan untuk reminder
